alerts.title: Weight Gain and Metabolic Changes
alerts.message: Guidelines suggest monitoring for metabolic changes with DTG. Patient has gained significant weight since starting TLD, with a current BMI of 32.4 kg/m² and impaired fasting glucose. DTG is a known cause of weight gain, but family history of Type 2 Diabetes should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor glucose and lipid profiles regularly
